description: Vue 3 / Nuxt composable for typed HTTP requests with SSR support, IndexedDB caching and smart loading
liveDemoDesc: Toggle options to see the difference in behavior. Increase the delay to make skeletons visible and feel the cache effect.
ssrInfo: SSR (Server-Side Rendering) — data is loaded on the server via onServerPrefetch and hydrated on the client via useState. The user sees content immediately, without skeletons. For the demo — enable SSR and reload the page.
cacheInfo: Cache (IndexedDB) — on the first request, data is saved in IndexedDB. On remounting, the cache returns data instantly (no skeleton), while fresh data is loaded in the background. Try: enable Cache, wait for load, then click "Remount" — data appears instantly.
delayInfo: Artificial Delay — simulates a slow server response via setTimeout. Increase to 2000–3000ms to see skeletons and compare: with cache data appears instantly, without cache — waits the full delay.
behavior2: First time: Skeleton → Data (and saving to IndexedDB). Repeatedly: Data instantly from cache, background request updates
behavior3: Data is rendered on the server. HTML already contains content, no skeleton
behavior4: SSR renders on full page load. Cache is not filled via SSR (data comes via hydration). On client navigation — normal request + cache
optInitDesc: Initial request parameters: params, query and standard RequestInit
optSsrDesc: Performs request on server via onServerPrefetch. Data is hydrated on client via Nuxt useState
optCacheDesc: Enables data caching in IndexedDB. Cache returns data instantly, fresh data is loaded in the background
optTtlDesc: Cache lifetime in milliseconds (default 24 hours). Expired records are deleted automatically
optLazyDesc: If true, request is not executed automatically. Data is loaded manually via fetch()
optKeyDesc: Unique key for Nuxt useState. Allows to share state between components
optEffectDesc: Callback called when data is received. config contains cache, isServer, params, query
retDataDesc: Reactive response data. null until first load
retLoadingDesc: Whether a network request is currently in progress
retCacheDesc: Whether loading from cache is in progress. Becomes false right after reading from IndexedDB
retFreshDesc: Whether fresh data is received from server (not from cache)
retFetchDesc: Method for manual call / re-request with new parameters
typesDesc: This module automatically stitches your types together! By default, it looks for *.convention.ts files in the conventions/ folder. You can change this in nuxt.config.ts (e.g. for DDD architecture: domains/**/entities/*.convention.ts).
typesNote: Just default export an interface in the file, and your IDE will instantly pick up all URLs, query parameters, and response structures for both useHttp and the standalone request function!
typesWarning: Important: You cannot pass generic types manually (e.g. useHttp<Todo[]>). The module strictly enforces your URL strings based on your conventions!
